answer: By the signal of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, published publicly on failure, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the pearl of a task receipt, and the delta is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
